title: The chat follows the agent's work into the panes
body:
The chat TUI receives typed ACP events: `tool_call` and `tool_call_update`
with a kind, a status and locations, the `fs/read_text_file` and
`fs/write_text_file` requests it answers, and plan updates. Nothing in
decade reacts to them yet.

## Proposal

A fixed table from ACP event to decade socket message, applied by the chat
with no model in the loop:

| Event | Pane action |
|---|---|
| read tool call with a location | code pane shows the file at the line |
| edit tool call completed with a diff | code pane shows the file and marks the changed lines |
| fs/read_text_file request | same as a read tool call, and earlier |
| search tool call | nothing, unless the content carries hits |
| execute tool call | nothing in the first version |
| plan update | nothing until a plan pane exists |

Each rule can be switched off per pane by the user. The limit is stated on
the milestone: this expresses only what the agent's activity implies, never
an intention such as "highlight only these lines".

## Open

- Debounce: an agent reading ten files in a second should not flip the code
  pane ten times. Probably the last one wins after a short delay.
